event_name: MOPAR NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge

pairs.note:
Marc Ingwersen has one national event final-round appearance, in 2026. His most recent final was at Martin in 2026. This is his 85th race overall and his fifth at this event; his first appearance here was in 2022. His best starting position here is eighth, which he has earned three times, and his career best is fourth. His average starting position is 9.5 at this event and 10.3 for his career.

Geno Scali was the 2003 Pro Stock Motorcycle World Champion and has four national event wins. His most recent win was at Sonoma in 2003. This is his 184th race overall and his ninth at this event; his first appearance here was in 2001. His best starting position here is third, in 2003 and 2004, and his career best is first, achieved three times. His average starting position is 9.4 at this event and 9.0 for his career.

A good side-by-side, both down the groove with decent passes.
